conventions.border: rect x=3 y=3 w=794 h=594 stroke #052049 width 6

palette.red: #e61048 — prohibition mark ONLY, never decoration or severity

conventions.strokes: object outlines 5-6px navy; internal detail 4px; consistent butt/round joins per shape family

furniture.numberChip: yellow 56px square at 26,26 with navy 4px stroke, 26px 800 navy text (e.g. 02–03 uses width 96)
furniture.topicChip: white rect navy 4px stroke top-right at y 30, 20px 800 tracked caps
furniture.statusTag: navy rect bottom-right ~y556 h24, white 12px 800 tracked caps: DRAFT ARTWORK · PENDING CLINICAL REVIEW

conventions.labels: UPPERCASE Helvetica 800, 18-20px, letter-spacing 1.4-1.6, fill #29405d, at most 4 words each, never prose
conventions.figures: big numbers/durations use font-family Granjon, 'Adobe Garamond Pro', Garamond, 'Times New Roman', serif
hardRules: No wound, incision, blood, or technique-being-performed depiction; the guide figure and objects only
No red outside the prohibition mark; no urgency tiers; equal visual weight within lists
Every number/threshold/phone exactly as specified; nothing on-card beyond the brief's text; labels <=4 caps words
Composition must read in under 2 seconds; generous negative space; one alignment axis per beat; keep all labels clear of the status tag
Adult calm register — never babyish (the hair cue on the figure is mandatory), never alarmist
conventions.figure: A consistent neutral ADULT guide figure IS part of the grammar: copy the <defs> group id='head' (profile head with ear, short navy hair, shoulders) VERBATIM from preview/assets/cards/frame-01.svg and reuse via <use href='#head'> at scale ~0.72. Also copy #tape when needed. Never draw wounds, incisions, blood, hands performing technique, or facial features beyond the exemplar's profile.
conventions.stepMarkers: Beats are NOT numbered (top-to-bottom reading order). True in-panel sequences use small NAVY squares 34px with white 800 numerals. The yellow square is reserved for the frame-number chip, top-left only.
conventions.divider: Section divider inside a card = solid #ddecf0 bar 4px tall (never gray, never low-opacity navy).
conventions.annotationTag: Content annotations (like TAPE) are NAVY-FILLED rects with white 17px 800 tracked caps — visually distinct from the white furniture chips.
conventions.insets: Detail insets magnify 1:1 what they explain: same object, same angle, same relative position, enlarged; keep all inset content at least 12px inside the rim; yellow #feb80a ring marks the found detail; anchored by navy leader line + source dot.
conventions.statusTag: Status tag = OUTLINED meta chrome: stock fill, navy 2px stroke, navy 11px 800 caps text, rect x=462 y=554 w=312 h=26. Content annotation tags (like TAPE) are the opposite: navy-filled, white text. Never swap these.
conventions.arrows: Teal arrows mean STATE CHANGE between two drawn states, nothing else. Detail insets are anchored by a thin navy 4px leader line with a 7px navy dot at the source point — never an arrow. One arrow spec: 12px shaft, 36x34 solid head.
conventions.yellowRule: Yellow #feb80a appears ONLY as: frame-number chip, marker ring, checklist tick squares, timeline marker square. Never as object fill or decoration.
conventions.targetRegister: North star (John, 2026-08-23): classic airline seat-back safety cards — numbered sequential panels, A/B two-path sequences, red-circle prohibitions on specific objects, circular magnifying insets, arrows for state change, near-zero text, scene-based figures performing the action. V1 draft cards keep that STRUCTURE with a neutral figure + objects (hands-on technique and wound anatomy are surgeon-gated); the post-review illustrated pass upgrades figures to full scene register (like the approved frame-13 illustration) while keeping the UCSF palette: navy/teal/yellow on stock, red = prohibition only.

cards.story: Two mutually exclusive care paths after the bandage comes off.
cards.layout: Vertical split: full-height navy 3px divider at x=400. Column headers at top of each half.
cards.left: Header label TAPE PRESENT. Tape-strip icon (torn-end strip with 3 cross lines, like the exemplar inset). Serif figure '3 days' with label KEEP DRY. Prohibition: red ring+slash over a cotton-swab-and-droplet icon, label NO CLEANING BEFORE DAY 3.
cards.right: Header label NO TAPE. Three stacked micro-steps, each: yellow step square (1/2/3) + object icon + label. 1: cotton swab icon, label CLEAN GENTLY · 2× A DAY. 2: two small bottles side by side, label MIX 50 / 50 (peroxide + distilled water are caption content, not card content). 3: ointment tube icon, label APPLY OINTMENT.

cards.story: Two milestones on the recovery timeline, plus reassurance that stitches need nothing.
cards.layout: Horizontal timeline rail (navy 4px line) across upper half with two stops (navy dot + yellow marker square on the active metaphor). Below, one detail inset.
cards.stop1: At ~x260: shower-head icon (arc with 3 teal falling drops), serif figure 'Day 3', label SHOWER + HAIR OK.
cards.stop2: At ~x560: calendar icon (grid with one teal-marked square), serif figure '≈ 2 weeks', label WOUND CHECK + EAR EXAM.
cards.inset: Cream detail circle bottom-center-left: a thread/knot icon whose tail fades into dashes (dissolving), tag chip STITCHES, label DISSOLVE ON THEIR OWN.

cards.story: Call only when all three signs are true at once — an AND rule, not a menu.
cards.layout: Three equal horizontal condition rows (white fill, navy 5px stroke, identical size) joined on the left by a vertical bracket + plus signs between rows to encode AND. Footer action strip.
cards.rows: Each row pairs the guide figure with an abstract mark near the ear region (use #head at small scale ~0.4 on the left of each row, identical across rows): Row 1: three navy radiating arcs at the behind-ear area + label RED AND SWOLLEN. Row 2: small calendar (2 marked day squares) + label NOT BETTER IN 1–2 DAYS. Row 3: three concentric tenderness arcs converging at the spot + label HURTS WHEN TOUCHED. AND-logic: bold plus signs between rows on the left bracket.
cards.footer: Navy strip across bottom above status tag: white phone-handset icon + white label CALL YOUR SURGEON OR CLINIC.

cards.story: Four independent reasons to call — any single one is enough. OR rule, equal weight.
cards.layout: 2×2 grid of equal cells (white fill, navy 5px stroke, identical size, 16px gutters). Footer action strip identical to frame-06's.
cards.cells: Cell A: thermometer with navy threshold line + serif '101.5°F' + label FEVER ABOVE THIS. Cell B: guide figure (#head scale ~0.42) with two droplets at the behind-ear area + label SWELLING OR FLUID. Cell C: three equal glyphs (zigzag ache mark, radiant sun, half-filled battery) + label HEADACHE · LIGHT · LETHARGY. Cell D: outlined question-mark speech bubble + label ANY QUESTION OR CONCERN.
cards.footer: Navy strip: white phone icon + CALL YOUR SURGEON OR CLINIC.

cards.story: Two phone routes, exactly as the source separates them. The numbers are the heroes.
cards.layout: Two equal side-by-side panels (identical size). Left panel white fill; right panel cream #fff5cf fill; both navy 5px stroke. No red anywhere.
cards.leftPanel: Header label ROUTINE QUESTIONS. Phone-handset icon. Serif tabular figure '415-353-2148' as the dominant element. Sub-labels: NURSING LINE · CALLBACK IN 12 HOURS, then NO CALL? CALL AGAIN.
cards.rightPanel: Header label EMERGENCY. Phone-handset icon. Serif tabular figure '415-476-1000'. Sub-label: ASK FOR THE OTOLARYNGOLOGY RESIDENT ON CALL (may wrap to two lines, stays caps 14px).
onFrame: ASK FOR THE OTOLARYNGOLOGY RESIDENT ON CALL

cards.story: Closing recap: the three parts, replayable in any order.
cards.layout: Three numbered rows (yellow step squares 1/2/3 + icon + label), then a centered replay mark below.
cards.rows: 1: bandage-roll icon + CARE FOR THE SURGERY SITE. 2: phone-handset icon + WHEN TO CALL. 3: calendar icon + FIRST PROGRAMMING VISITS.
cards.replay: Teal circular-arrow replay glyph (open circle with arrowhead), label REPLAY ANY PART.
